## Which behavior is this about?

<!-- One sentence in plain language. -->

## What kind of change is it?

- [ ] A new rule
- [ ] What should happen has changed (number at the end of the stamp went up, and `Comment:` says why)
- [ ] Clearer wording only
- [ ] Where it applies (`Needs`) changed
- [ ] A rule no longer applies (`Status: rejected`, not deleted)

## Before asking for review

- [ ] Each rule describes one thing a person could watch happen
- [ ] The rationale says why
- [ ] Links to Figma, Runway or the original Connect thread are included where they exist
- [ ] `Needs` lists the apps where people see it (the reviewer adds the systems behind them)
